maya: FYI billing ops flagged a small duplicate token charge during our canary at 03:10 UTC. Looks like a toolcall replay after a stream handoff.

jon: Any traces?

maya: Short snippet: ```{"sid":"s1","rid":"r100","ev":[{"e":"toolcall","id":"tc-A","tok":15},{"e":"handoff"},{"e":"reconnect","rid":"r100-1"},{"e":"toolcall","id":"tc-A","tok":15}]}```

emma: We dedupe on (customer, request_id, toolcall_id) today, so reconnects double-charge.

lucas: Proposal: router injects x-toolcall-global-id that survives reconnects. Ledger dedupes on (customer, toolcall_global_id) when present.

jon: Short-term: mark second event provisional in billing stream so CS doesn't auto-invoice. Can we wire a provisional flag?

maya: Yes. Also add metric token.charges{status=provisional|confirmed,origin=initial|replay} for dashboards.

emma: Edge: clients that retry legitimately will have different payloads. Only collapse when payload_hash matches or when server-generated id present.

lucas: Action: jon PR schema + provisional flag, me: router canary to attach global id, emma: ops reconciliation plan.

billing-bot: alert: provisional_charge_rate spike 03:10:22 for cust:test-9 (1200 tokens/min)

maya: Thanks — let's start canary and monitor for missing global ids. :thumbsup:
